doc: The zonal mean coverage of the seed-1 Earth map in 5-degree bands (metrics.zonal_profile) against climate.target_zonal_coverage: the per-row calibration solves each row's mean to the target (bisection to 1e-9 on the unsmoothed thresholds), so what remains is the smoothing of the thresholds over 2 degrees, the sub-texel noise and the 5-degree banding. Outputs: the band centers, the map's band means, the target at the band centers, the target averaged over the rows of each band (the like-for-like value), the residual (band mean - band-mean target), the row-level residual (row mean - target at the row, 512 rows) and its largest absolute value, and the mean and std (ddof 1) of the band residual over seeds 1 to 8. A port keeps its band residual inside mean +- 3 std of the seeds. Measured on seed 1: the row residual has an rms of 0.017 and a maximum of 0.067 away from the poles, but the first and last rows of the map are far off (north pole rows 0 to 6: +0.15, -0.06, -0.34, -0.27, -0.17, -0.15, -0.19: a pole row is one point, so its coverage cannot follow its target, and the 2-degree smoothing of the thresholds spreads that across the neighbouring rows); the polar bands of the 5-degree profile carry the same residual (-0.078 in the last band). Tolerance: 10x the change of a band mean under +-1e-4 noise (1.1e-5) for the band values (2e-4), 1e-3 for the row residual (a row mean of 1024 texels).

params.resampling: none: measure.load box-averages maps WIDER than 2048 down to the reference; the 1024 map is measured as generated (patches are bilinear samples of it)
